svg.title: Choose the account. Set command permissions.
svg.desc: An approved project envrc selects the work account home. That home supplies settings and credentials to a new Codex CLI or VS Code session, which connects to the chosen model provider. Verify the account in the application. Generated commands use optional native sandbox permissions: workspace-write permits project and temporary-file writes, while read-only restricts file writes. Approval requests follow the effective Codex policy. The application and model-provider connection remain outside the command sandbox.

svg.text: Choose the account. Set command permissions.
One named home supplies settings and credentials to a new CLI or VS Code session.
Account routing and command permissions are separate controls. Check the effective account and permissions.
